title: Fix Back returning to the wrong scroll position
request: Doug: 'Yes scroll fix' (answering: fix the shared scroll-restore hook so Back from a team page returns to the same scroll position, as found while polishing the History page)

criteria.text: History: Back after a team link restores the exact scroll position in 10 of 10 runs with the data cached and 10 of 10 after a reload of the team page (real browser, 390px, fake data; before: 3/10 and 2/10)
criteria.evidence: Measured 2026-11-06, History 390px, fake data, fresh browser per run, within 1px of the offset before the click: dev server cached 10 of 10 observed, after a reload of the team page 10 of 10, slow phone (CPU x4, delayed data) 6 of 6; production build cached 10 of 10 and reload 10 of 10. Same scripts before the fix: 6 of 10 and 2 of 10 this round (earlier runs 3 of 10 and 2 of 10; production build 7 of 10 and 5 of 10). Lead spot check on the final code: cached 4 of 4, reload 4 of 4, reduced-motion reload 3 of 3. Saved offset equalled the offset before the click in every after-fix run. Files: .factory/evidence/T-261106-fix-back-returning-to-th/SUMMARY-after2.txt, .factory/evidence/T-261106-fix-back-returning-to-th/SUMMARY-all.txt. Safari/iOS not tested.

criteria.text: Same at 1280px, and /stats, /teams and /insights still restore after a team link (or are marked not tried if the fake data has no link)
criteria.evidence: 1280px: cached 5 of 5 observed, reload 5 of 5 (before 5 of 5 and 3 of 5). /teams 390px: 5 of 5 at offset 304 (round 1 had regressed to 0 of 5, fixed by the watch window) and 5 of 5 at each of 100/200/250. /stats 1 of 1 and /insights 1 of 1 after a footer link: /insights was NOT tried with a team link, the fake data has none there. Lead: bottom tab bar (Schedule) then Back at 390px, /stats, /teams, /insights 3 of 3 each after the fix. Same test on the OLD hook (lead, before/OLD-top-*.json): /stats 3 of 3, /insights 3 of 3, /teams 0 of 3 (landed at 86px, saved offset right). Files: .factory/evidence/T-261106-fix-back-returning-to-th/SUMMARY-after2.txt, .factory/evidence/T-261106-fix-back-returning-to-th/before/OLD-top-teams.json.

criteria.text: A reader who scrolls while a slow restore is still waiting is not pulled back, and Back no longer glides from the top
criteria.evidence: Reader takes over, 390px, slow list: wheel 3 of 3 observed with no hook scrollTo after the event and scrollY unchanged; wheel during the 1 s watch window 3 of 3; scrollbar press at 1280px (classic 15px scrollbar, headless Chromium): pointerdown reached window 3 of 3 and the restore stopped. Control runs without a reader kept trying. Back no longer glides: distinct frame values 0 then the saved offset in 3 of 3 traced runs (before: 0,3,19,81,93,101,105,108,110,111); with reduced motion 0,111,900 where 111 is the browser's own entry restore. Saving is back on 4 s after the restore in every set. Files: .factory/evidence/T-261106-fix-back-returning-to-th/after2/dev-glide*.out, .factory/evidence/T-261106-fix-back-returning-to-th/after2/dev-reader-*.json. Safari/iOS not tested; find-in-page, screen reader and voice control send no input event (restore can fight them while it runs, read from code, not tried).

criteria.text: New hook tests exist and fail on the old code (mutation proof); existing tests unchanged; six checks pass at the final commit
criteria.evidence: New file src/hooks/__tests__/useScrollRestoration.test.tsx, 43 tests, all pass; 13 of the 42 written before the settle window fail on the round-1 hook and 20 of 30 failed on the original hook. Mutation runs: every planned mutation fails at least one test except two redundancy-only checks of the cancelled flag (stop() already calls cancelAnimationFrame and clearTimeout); hook restored by sha256 after each run. git diff 2a1c90c 50ee277 on test files shows only the one new file. Six checks PASS at 50ee277 (integrity, typecheck, lint, knip, build, unit) via factory check. Lead re-ran the new test file, prettier and eslint on both files: pass.

criteria.text: Independent code review approves the final commit
Docs that call History/other scroll restore best effort or untested are updated with the new measurements; totals and links still true
criteria.evidence: 15 docs under docs/product-description updated (navigation, B-14, browse-teams, team-details, past-seasons, standings, insights, on-a-phone, accessibility, goal, five verification files). Lead recount by script: 1,958 items; P1 suspected-bug rows 120 at HEAD before, 115 now (NAV-02, BROWSE-04, BROWSE-37, TEAM-33, PHONE-22 lost the mark). Link check 2,750 links, 0 broken. Two claims were corrected after the lead's before-fix test: the overwrite of the saved spot is measured on /history after a team link only (6 of 10 before), not for the bottom tab bar (9 of 9 right before the fix); /stats and /insights already came back before the fix, so the pages no longer credit the fix there. Every changed passage says fake data, headless Chromium, Safari/iOS not tested.

reviews.summary: Independent plan review. Both causes real and complete, no third cause found; no reason to reject. Cause 2 arithmetic verified (1153-844=309, hook line 85 tests scrollHeight >= saved, page shell is min-h-dvh so the test is almost always true). Cause 1: router changes window.location.pathname before any DOM swap, so a pathname guard is correct whatever React's cleanup timing. Three blocking repairs accepted and written into the plan as AMENDMENTS: (1) one stop() helper with a cancelled flag and the rAF id, called from exhaustion, user input and cleanup, so an unmounted page can never scroll the next page (test + mutation); (2) test plan repairs: global scrollTo stub in setupTests, clamp stub must accept both call shapes, fake rAF/cancelAnimationFrame, userEvent under fake timers, jsdom path is / while the router is /history, no exported constants (knip), fractional case; (3) acceptance: report n of n observed, assert the saved offset equals the pre-click scrollY in every run, scrollTo spy, vary offsets, also run the production build, add a CPU/network throttle run. Non-blocking adopted: capture the path at effect start for the guard; reword Cause 1 to what was measured; try/catch fallback for behavior instant (iOS 16.0 Safari unverified, WebKit not installed); keydown ignores repeat. Could not verify: browser behaviour, scrollbar pointerdown, iOS 16 instant, lint on new code.

interventions.why: Owner answered 'Yes scroll fix' to my question whether to fix the shared scroll-restore hook as its own task (and approved the History task, the remembered-state addition, the 27px Champions links and the hand-edited criteria).
